kind: additive wire event; no DB schema change

changed_h3_mapping.name: budget_calculated
changed_h3_mapping.meaning: Observed explicit opening of the existing group-cost breakdown for a fully specified, valid, reviewed personal calculation
eligibility: own native details toggle to open
no missing or incomplete cost lines
dates both omitted or valid budgetDateCounts
changed_h3_mapping.zero: Explicit zero is known; blank is unknown even for zero nights. Existing selected lodging basis determines the active amount
excluded: projected estimate ranges without exact manual costs
initial mount or restored/shared snapshot alone
draft edits/acknowledgement while breakdown already open
changed_h3_mapping.payload: Existing random event_id/anonymous_session_id and bounded page_type/source/campaign only. No deal_slug, amounts, dates, labels, events, totals, profile, plan ID/revision/token, URL/query/hash or completion fields
changed_h3_mapping.deduplication: Existing viewEvents: once per observed URL visit + anonymous session, not per plan or input revision; hash changes alone do not reset
changed_h3_mapping.consent: Existing analyticsAllowed at send time, no replay of an already-open breakdown on grant; revocation clears existing session/dedup state
changed_h3_mapping.delivery: Best effort, no retry. Blocked send stays deduplicated for the visit; calculation/storage are unaffected
changed_h3_mapping.metric: Existing protected summary.by_event.BUDGET_CALCULATED; existing budget_usage remains BUDGET_USE
changed_h3_mapping.limitations: Inputs/acknowledgement are user assertions, not verified supplier prices or actual spending. No guarantee of deliberate user action if opened programmatically; interactions before hydration can be missed. Public POST cannot verify client eligibility. Restored budgets can complete without BUDGET_USE in the same period

unchanged_h3_mappings: TRIP_UPDATE retains v2, DEAL_DETAILS_OPEN retains v3; all other baseline definitions/proxies remain unchanged
remaining: protected engagement dashboard metrics with explicit denominators
